name: Naturecraft
body:
School transmutation; Level druid/shaman 0, ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.
Target, Effect, or Area see text
Duration see text
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

By channeling your connection to nature, you can create one of the following effects:

You create a small sensory effect to predict the weather in the next 24 hours. The exact manifestation for each weather type is unique to the caster.
You can cause a seed to sprout, a flower to blossom, or some other opening/blossoming of a plant.
You can create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect related to nature, like a small animal call, a snapping twig, leaves in the wind, animal smells, etc. The effect must fit in a 5-foot area. A Will save can disbelieve this effect.
You can instantly light or snuff out a small flame. The flame cannot be larger than a torch.
